# Continuation brief

You are picking up an in-progress task in the hmsc-int world editor. Read this file fully, then execute. The user has NOT been re-prompted. The full approved plan is at `/home/siah/.claude/plans/recursive-cooking-bentley.md` — read it. Reqs on the board: `req_1473` (flora) and `req_1472` (water), both in `doing` claimed by `claude`. CLAUDE.md rules apply: NO Task/Explore/Plan subagents (read files directly), commit to `main` only with explicit paths (never `-A`), end commit messages with the Co-Authored-By line for "Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context)".

## The goal (verbatim asks)

req_1473: "this is actually something that goes with the tree painter and grass painter. is a bit of a rework on where the painting lives. heres the problem: i want to place grass, and tree inside of the grass. the current approach says i have 1 layer that i have to make a decision for this here. so either we need to introduce layering to the tile painter or need to put things into a different system. why does any of this matter for water, well think about what sits under water. either sand, rocks, cement. and because heightfields already control depth, water needs to arrive in two forms. the first, it needs to have its own tile painting for placement, but we need to also fill in for the heightfield in the space if its negative. so if i have a negative heightfield space and then i paint water tiles, that water should fill it. but we also will want to have swimming pools later on that will use the same water which pools will be through props and not this approach"

Follow-up ruling (grass model): "i think the better plan is to move grass into flora, here is why: beach grass needs sand. if grass is at the same tile level as sand, then you never can combinne them" → FULL DECOUPLE: ALL populations (grass blades, palms, bushes) live in the flora channel; ground tiles are only surfaces (grass/sand/asphalt/cement/soil).

Water ruling: "there is already a water painting tool, but the water that it paints is asshole. i didnt like it. so your largely just replacing this" → Phase 2 REPLACES the painted-water look with the stylized `~water~` pipeline (the water the user liked, proven in `cart/water_probe.tsx`: FBM waves + foam + Bayer dither), makes painted water reach the COMPILED game, and fills negative heightfield. Pools = future props, OUT OF SCOPE.

## Where things stand

Phase 1 is ~70% done, committed in two pieces (all on `main`):
- `f10508a3b` — flora DATA layer. New `cart/hmsc-int/floraData.ts` (FloraMap + FLORA_KINDS: grassSparse/grassMed/grassLush/grassDry, palmSparse/palmMed/palmDense, bush). 5th chunk channel `flora` (chunks.ts). chunkFloor.ts carries it (ChunkFloor.floraData, chunkToFloor encodes, floorToLandform → field.flora). landforms.ts LandformField.flora. grassPopulation.ts `eachPaintedCell` reads `field.flora` (not tiles); GRASS_KIND_LEVEL `grass`→`grassMed`; levelByIndex over FLORA_KINDS. palmPopulation.ts PALM_KIND_DENSITY `palm`→`palmMed`. mapStore.ts persists flora (ChunkSnap.flora + floraLegend, v2→v3) + a v2→v3 MIGRATION (POP_TILE_TO_FLORA) that splits old population GROUND tiles into flora + plain ground on load.
- `7be4f9c86` — flora PAINT layer. PaintCanvas.tsx Layer `'flora'` + stampFloraAtGraph (writes chunk.flora, marks tileDirty) + internal `activeFlora` state. TargetDock.tsx FLORA chip. BrushRail.tsx `FloraSection` (labelled ChipGrid). PainterRail.tsx flora case.

VERIFIED: cart bundles clean (`BUNDLE_FROM_HARNESS=1 tools/v8cli scripts/cart-bundle.js cart/hmsc-int/index.tsx --out /tmp/x.js`); `tools/rjit game bake` migrates the live `main` map's populations into flora (grass 16984, bush 66248, palm 575 trunks / 13801 fronds). The user has NOT yet visually tested the flora painter in the dev host.

## What you need to do next

Do these in order; commit each as a verified increment (explicit paths; the clobber lesson is real — 4-5 sessions run in parallel, never leave finished work uncommitted in shared files).

1. **2D painter overlay for flora.** Flora shows in the iso-3D preview but NOT in the flat 2D painter view. Add a flora section to the painter shader, mirroring the zone channel: `cart/hmsc-int/painterSurface.ts` (`encodePainterSurface` pushes encoded sections: emphasis header, tiles, road ribbon, height, zones, water — add a flora section, twin of `encodeZoneSection`) and `cart/hmsc-int/painterView.wgsl.ts` (parse + composite it; tint flora cells by FLORA kind colour). Add a flora emphasis weight (PaintCanvas builds the emphasis header ~line 731-734: `road`/`height`/`zone` weights — add `flora`). Goal: painting flora shows a visible marker/tint in the 2D view.

2. **Remove redundant population kinds from the GROUND tile palette.** grass/grassSparse/grassDry/grassLush/palm/palmSparse/palmDense/bush still exist as GROUND tiles in `cart/hmsc-int/design.ts` (TileKind union), `cart/hmsc-int/world/tileKinds.ts` (TILE_KIND_DEFINITIONS), `cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/tiles.ts` (TILE_KIND_DEFINITIONS). They're now redundant (painting them as ground grows nothing — population reads flora). KEEP a plain green `grass` GROUND surface (lawn). Remove the rest. RISK: grep every reference first — `grep -rn "'grassSparse'\|'grassLush'\|'grassDry'\|'palmSparse'\|'palmDense'\|'palmMed'\|'bush'" cart/hmsc-int` — and the migration in mapStore POP_TILE_TO_FLORA references these as STRING legend names (safe, they're just strings). The v2→v3 migration handles existing maps regardless of TILE_KINDS membership (it intercepts population names before buildTileRemap). Verify the bake still migrates after removal.

3. **Phase 2 — water.** Per plan section "Phase 2": (a) promote water to its OWN painter layer (`water` Layer + TargetDock entry) replacing the height-tool `HeightMode 'water'/'waterSlope'` sub-mode in PaintCanvas; painting water sets `chunk.water` AND fills any negative `chunk.height` cell in the footprint to surface 0. (b) Make painted water reach COMPILE: `cart/hmsc-int/packageMap.ts:339` only encodes `encodeWaterBodies(state.world.waterBodies)` (catalog water); ALSO run `floorsToWaterBodies(floors)` (`chunkFloor.ts`, already used in editor preview) at bake and merge into the WATER lump. (c) Good look: make painted water render like `cart/water_probe.tsx` (the `~water~` pipeline; `WaterBody.tsx` already uses `textureKey="~water~"`); investigate why current painted water looks bad (likely thin/flat field vs the probe's deep field) and fix the field/depth. The compiled loader already routes water bodies to `~water~` (`world_loader.zig`, `scene3d_tex_key="~water~"`). (d) Retire the old height-tool water sub-mode (clean removal, user dislikes it).

## Files in play

- `cart/hmsc-int/floraData.ts` — the flora kind table + FloraMap (done; reference for ids).
- `cart/hmsc-int/painterSurface.ts` + `cart/hmsc-int/painterView.wgsl.ts` — 2D painter shader; add the flora overlay section here (step 1).
- `cart/hmsc-int/PaintCanvas.tsx` — Layer enum, stamp dispatch (painterCapabilities), emphasis header, brush color; water-layer promotion (step 3a).
- `cart/hmsc-int/design.ts`, `cart/hmsc-int/world/tileKinds.ts`, `cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/tiles.ts` — the THREE synced ground tile tables; remove population kinds (step 2), keep them in lockstep (same order/indices).
- `cart/hmsc-int/mapStore.ts` — persistence + POP_TILE_TO_FLORA migration (done; don't break it when removing tiles).
- `cart/hmsc-int/packageMap.ts` — bake lump assembly; merge painted water into WATER lump (step 3b).
- `cart/hmsc-int/chunkFloor.ts` — floorToWaterBody / floorsToWaterBodies (water→bake); floorToLandform (flora carry, done).
- `cart/water_probe.tsx` — the GOOD water look reference. `cart/hmsc-int/render3d/WaterBody.tsx` — editor water mesh (already `~water~`).
- `framework/world/world_loader.zig` — compiled water render (already `~water~`); read-only reference unless step 3 needs loader changes.

## Constraints, conventions, and gotchas

- Build/verify: `tools/rjit game bake` (bakes the live map; logs `[bake] grass/bush/palm: N`). Cart compile check: `BUNDLE_FROM_HARNESS=1 tools/v8cli scripts/cart-bundle.js cart/hmsc-int/index.tsx --out /tmp/x.js`. TS unit suites: bundle with `tools/esbuild <file>.test.ts --bundle --outfile=zig-out/game/tests/x.js --format=iife --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --alias:@reactjit=$PWD/runtime --alias:@game=$PWD/cart/hmsc-int/game --log-level=error` then `tools/v8cli zig-out/game/tests/x.js`. Keep `render3d/groundResolve` + `compile/worldGeometry` suites green.
- You CANNOT drive the painter UI headlessly; the headless proof camera (`tools/rjit game shot`) only frames spawn and won't show scattered flora/water. The USER verifies UI/visuals in their dev host (they have `tools/rjit dev` + an auto-push watcher running — do NOT restart it). This is the established verification pattern this whole task.
- THREE tile tables (design/world.tileKinds/game.kinds.tiles) are hand-synced — same kinds, same order, indices must match. `world/tileKinds.ts` is the canonical one population/painter read; `game/kinds/tiles.ts` npc has an extra `cover` field, render uses `HMSC_TILE_TEXTURE_KEYS` vs `TEX`.
- Flora kind NAMES match the population specs (GRASS_KIND_LEVEL/PALM_KIND_DENSITY/BUSH_KIND_LEVEL) on purpose — `grassMed`/`palmMed` (NOT `grass`/`palm`). Don't reintroduce `grass`/`palm` as flora ids.
- Grass `grass` is BOTH a ground surface (green lawn, KEEP) and a migration source (a v2 `grass` GROUND tile → grassMed flora + grass ground). That's intended.
- mapStore MAP_FORMAT_V is now 3; v2 snapshots migrate on load (no flora grid → POP_TILE_TO_FLORA runs; flora grid present → load directly, no migration).
- Memory note saved: `~/.claude/projects/-home-siah-creative-reactjit/memory/project_flora_layer_decouple.md` (the beach-grass principle).
- Other hazards from this session (already fixed/committed, don't redo): crisp ground formula (4690d572c), palms/PalmTrunk/density/tunables/missing-texture-checkerboard (req_1443-1471). The "disk is truth, commit early" lesson is load-bearing here — uncommitted work in shared files HAS been clobbered by parallel sessions in this repo.

## What comes next (after this handoff's task is done)

Swimming pools as props using the same `~water~` look (the user flagged this explicitly as a later, prop-based path — NOT this task). Possibly: additive multi-flora per cell (grass blades AND a palm in the same cell beyond the sparse-overlap case) — low priority, palms are sparse so they already read as "trees in grass."

## How to report back

Commit each step to `main` with explicit paths + the Co-Authored-By line. After each commit, tell the user what to test in their dev host (e.g. "paint FLORA over sand → beach grass"; "paint the WATER layer into a dug basin → it fills with stylized water; Compile → it ships"). When the whole rework is done (flora overlay + ground cleanup + water all working and the user confirms in-app), move `req_1473` and `req_1472` to review: `tools/request move <id> review --by claude --para "<≥120 char paragraph>" --shas <shas>`. Only the user flips review→done.
resolution: Completed the continuation scope: flora now has a visible 2D painter overlay, redundant population ground swatches were removed from the tile painter while preserving migrated flora data, and painted water is now its own WATER target that fills negative terrain to surface zero and ships through the compiled WATER lump.
